features.featureTitle: Update the Library page search bar container so it no longer uses fixed/sticky positioning and therefore does not follow the scroll or overlap content. Specifically, change the search bar wrapper in `frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.tsx` from `className="sticky ..."` to a non-sticky layout (`relative` or default/static flow), and remove the inline `style={{ top: 'var(--header-offset)' }}` that is only needed for sticky positioning.

Add a reusable CSS snippet (in `frontend/src/index.css`) that developers can apply to page-level search bars to ensure non-floating behavior, using `position: relative` (or static), `top: 0`, and an appropriate `z-index` that does not overlay content unexpectedly. Ensure the Library page search bar uses this class (or an equivalent Tailwind class set) so the positioning intent is explicit.
